results.question: Can I upload FERPA-protected student data to Claude at Syracuse?
results.answer:
Yes — with an important condition. Here's what the policy says:

## ✅ FERPA-Protected Data IS Permitted in Claude at Syracuse — When Logged In with Your NetID

When you access **Claude Enterprise** at [getclaude.syr.edu](https://getclaude.syr.edu) using your **Syracuse University credentials (NetID)**, you are permitted to work with **all data classification levels** of university data, which includes FERPA-protected student records [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].

The same rule applies to other SU-approved tools like Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini — the key is always being authenticated with your SU NetID/account [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].

---

## ⚠️ Important Caveats to Keep in Mind

Even though FERPA data is *permitted*, you should be aware of how your data is handled:

1. **Retention:** All data you upload or enter into Claude is **retained for 2 years** on the platform — even if you delete a chat, it remains on the backend for the full retention period [[488210484]].

2. **No training by default:** Your chats and uploaded data are **not used to train Claude models** by default. The only exception is if you explicitly submit feedback or bug reports [[488210484]].

3. **IT staff access:** Your data is inherently accessible to **authorized SU IT staff** for support, security, and maintenance purposes, governed by the IT Resources Acceptable Use policy and the Information Security Framework [[488210484]].

4. **Shared artifacts — be careful:** If you share a Claude Project or Claude Artifact with others, be cautious about what sensitive data may be included in those shared items [[488210484]].

5. **Incognito/Private chats are NOT fully private:** Even in Incognito mode, chats are still retained on the platform per the standard 2-year retention policy — they just won't appear in your visible chat history [[488210484]].

---

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can upload FERPA-protected student data to Claude at Syracuse, provided you are logged in with your **SU NetID** at getclaude.syr.edu. Just be mindful of the 2-year retention period and avoid sharing that data through Claude's sharing/artifact features inadvertently.

---

**Sources:** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]], [[488210484]]

results.question: How long does Anthropic retain my Claude chats?
results.answer:
Anthropic retains your Claude chat data for **2 years**. Here are the key details:

- **All data** — including chat history, projects, artifacts, and uploaded items — is retained for **2 years** [[488210484]].
- If you **delete** a chat or project, it will no longer be visible to you and won't factor into your personalized memories, but the deleted content is **still retained on the platform** for the full 2-year retention period [[488210484]].
- Even **Incognito chats**, while not saved to your chat history, are still retained on the Claude platform and follow the same 2-year retention policy [[488210484]].

---

**Sources:** [[488210484]]

results.question: How should I decide between Claude, Copilot, and Gemini for academic work?
results.answer:
Great news — there's a comprehensive hub that covers exactly this question. Here's a structured guide to help you choose:

---

## Choosing Between Claude, Copilot, and Gemini for Academic Work at Syracuse

All three tools are **approved for use with university data** (including sensitive classifications) as long as you're logged in with your SU NetID credentials [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]]. Here's how to decide:

---

### 🔵 Microsoft Copilot — Best if you live in Microsoft 365
- **Built directly into** Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, and OneNote — so if your academic work involves editing documents, analyzing spreadsheets, or collaborating in Teams, Copilot is the most seamlessly integrated option [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Powered by **OpenAI's GPT-4** model.
- Conversations are stored in your M365 mailbox and are **not used to train Microsoft's AI models** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Access: **m365.cloud.microsoft/chat**

---

### 🟢 Google Gemini — Best if you work in Google Workspace or need image/canvas tools
- Uses Google's **Gemini 2.5 Pro** model and includes **guided learning, image generation, and a canvas editor** — useful for visual or multimedia academic projects [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Does **not** have unrestricted access to your Google Drive — only files you explicitly share in a session [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Chats are **not human-reviewed** and **not used to train Google's AI models** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Access: **gemini.google.com/app** — must sign in as `NetID@g.syr.edu` (not your personal Gmail!) [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].

---

### 🟠 Claude Enterprise — Best for deep research, writing, and general-purpose AI assistance
- Positioned as a general-purpose **"intelligent digital colleague"** — no coding or technical knowledge required [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Excellent for **long-form writing, research synthesis, problem solving, and data analysis** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Features **memory/personalization** across chats and projects (configurable in Settings) [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Data is retained for **2 years** but is **never used to train Anthropic's models by default** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].
- Access requires a request at **getclaude.syr.edu** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]].

---

### Quick Decision Summary

| Question | Best Choice |
|---|---|
| Working in Word/Excel/Teams? | **Copilot** |
| Need image generation or a visual canvas? | **Gemini** |
| Heavy writing, research, or open-ended problem solving? | **Claude** |
| Want SU's own private AI platform for teaching & learning? | **mentorAI** (mentor.ai.syr.edu) |

---

### Data Policy: All Three Are Comparable
All three tools share the same core protections when used with your NetID:
- ✅ You **own your inputs and outputs**
- ✅ Your data is **not used for AI training by default**
- ✅ All are governed by SU's IT Resources Acceptable Use Policy [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]]

The main practical differences come down to **platform integration** and **specific features**, not data safety.

---

results.question: How do I install Claude Code on Windows?
results.answer:
Here is a complete guide to installing Claude Code on Windows:

---

## Installing Claude Code on Windows

### Step 1: Get Access to Claude Code
First, you need to obtain access to Claude Code. This is done through the purchasing process described on the *Purchase Claude Code and Claude API Access* page [[986841103]].

---

### Step 2: Install Claude Code & Development Tools

Syracuse University provides an automated PowerShell script (`Install-DevTools.ps1`) that handles everything for you. It auto-detects your system architecture (AMD64 or ARM64) and installs all required tools [[986841103]]:

| Tool | Version |
|---|---|
| Node.js | 24.12.0 |
| Git Portable | 2.52.0 |
| Python Embeddable | 3.14.3 |
| VS Code Portable | Latest |
| GitHub Desktop | Latest |
| PowerShell 7 | Latest |
| Claude Code | Latest |

**Where tools install:** By default, tools install to your **OneDrive** (`%OneDrive%\Apps-SU\[arch]\<ToolName>`) for automatic sync. Claude Code always installs locally to `%USERPROFILE%\.local\bin` [[986841103]].

#### A. Set the Execution Policy
Open PowerShell and run:
```powershell
Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Scope CurrentUser
```

#### B. Download the Script
Download [`Install-DevTools.ps1`](https://answers.atlassian.syr.edu/wiki/spaces/ITSAI/pages/986841103) and save it to your Downloads folder [[986841103]].

#### C. Remove the "Mark of the Web"
Windows blocks downloaded scripts by default. Unblock it with one of these methods:

- **Option 1 (Recommended):** Run in PowerShell:
  ```powershell
  Unblock-File -Path "$HOME\Downloads\Install-DevTools.ps1"
  ```
- **Option 2:** Right-click the file → **Properties** → check **Unblock** at the bottom → click **OK** [[986841103]].

#### D. Run the Script
```powershell
.\Install-DevTools.ps1
```

---

### Step 3: Configure Claude Code

Once installed, connect Claude Code to your Syracuse University account [[986841103]]:

1. Open a terminal and type `claude`
2. Choose your preferred text display style
3. Select **"Anthropic Console account"** (option 2) for your login method
4. A browser window will open — sign in with your **`netid@syr.edu`** credentials and select the **Syracuse University** organization if prompted
5. **Authorize** Claude Code in the browser
6. Return to the terminal and press **Enter twice** to trust the folder

✅ **You're all set!**

---

### Troubleshooting Tips
- If the script won't run due to Mark of the Web issues, you can bypass the policy for a single session:
  ```powershell
  Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process
  ```
- **32-bit systems are not supported** — only AMD64 and ARM64.
- If OneDrive is unavailable, use the `-Location Local` flag.
- Restart your terminal session if tools aren't recognized after installation [[986841103]].

---

**Sources:** 986841103

results.question: Does the Claude platform train on my data?
results.answer:
**No — by default, the Claude platform does not train on your data.**

Here's the full picture from Syracuse University's official FAQ:

- **No training by default:** Data that Syracuse University users upload and the chat sessions they create are **not used to train any Claude AI models** by default [[488210484]].
- **Exception — explicit feedback:** If you explicitly report feedback or bugs to Claude, then Claude *may* use your submission to train AI models [[488210484]].
- **Personalization features:** Claude does have optional personalization features that allow the platform to remember you and reference prior chat sessions when generating new outputs. These are **configurable by you** — you can adjust or disable them via the [Claude Settings page](https://claude.ai/settings/features) [[488210484]].

So in summary: your normal chats and uploads are safe from being used as training data, but if you proactively submit feedback or bug reports, that content may be used for training purposes.

---
**Sources:** [[488210484]]

results.question: Can I use Claude while traveling outside the US?
results.answer:
Great, I have all the information needed. Here's the answer:

## Using Claude While Traveling Outside the US

**It depends on which country you're visiting.** Anthropic restricts access to Claude from certain countries, and this is an important consideration for SU users traveling abroad [[488210484]].

### Key Points:

1. **Check the supported countries list first.** Before traveling, visit [Anthropic's Supported Countries page](https://www.anthropic.com/supported-countries) to confirm Claude is available in your destination [[488210484]].

2. **Attempting access from a prohibited country can get your account banned.** If you try to use Claude from a country where it isn't available, your Syracuse University Claude account may be **permanently banned by Anthropic** [[488210484]].

3. **If your account is banned**, SU cannot intervene — you would need to appeal directly to Anthropic through their support system at [Anthropic's Appeals page](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241253-safeguards-warnings-and-appeals). Note that approval is not guaranteed, and Syracuse University has no ability to influence Anthropic's ban or appeal decisions [[488210484]].

### Recommendation:
✅ Always check [Anthropic's Supported Countries list](https://www.anthropic.com/supported-countries) **before** traveling internationally and attempting to access Claude.

---

**Sources:** [[488210484]]

results.question: What is mentorAI and how is it different from regular Claude?
results.answer:
Here's a full breakdown of **mentorAI** and how it differs from regular **Claude** at Syracuse University:

---

## What is mentorAI?

mentorAI is a **Syracuse University-run AI platform** that enables AI-powered, *personalized* assistants for students, faculty, and staff [[544505857]]. It is accessible at [mentor.ai.syr.edu](https://mentor.ai.syr.edu/).

It is built around two main audiences:

- **Students:** Can create custom study mentors tailored to their courses and textbooks. The AI adapts to their learning pace, offers targeted feedback and practice questions, and grounds every answer in course materials with transparent citations [[544505857]].
- **Faculty:** Can build course-specific AI teaching assistants to handle repetitive questions, assist with assignment review, generate lesson plans and quizzes, and answer student FAQs — using only faculty-approved content to ensure accuracy and integrity [[544505857]].

---

## How is mentorAI Different from Regular Claude?

| Feature | mentorAI | Claude (Claude Chat) |
|---|---|---|
| **Purpose** | Personalized learning/teaching assistants grounded in specific course materials | General-purpose conversational AI for writing, analysis, research, coding, etc. |
| **Content grounding** | Answers are grounded in your uploaded course materials, with citations | Responds from its broad pre-trained knowledge (plus any files you upload) |
| **Who creates the AI** | Faculty or students build and configure custom "mentors" | Anthropic builds and configures the model; SU configures org-level settings |
| **Audience targeting** | Mentors can be configured for specific courses, audiences, and learning goals [[567279621]] | Open-ended — any SU user can ask it anything |
| **Platform** | SU-hosted at mentor.ai.syr.edu [[544505857]] | Hosted by Anthropic at claude.ai; SU has an Enterprise agreement [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]] |
| **Approval status** | Approved SU tool, accessible with NetID credentials [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]] | Also approved; access via getclaude.syr.edu [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]] |

In short, **mentorAI is a specialized, education-focused platform** for building structured AI tutors and teaching assistants tied to specific course content, while **Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant** suitable for a wide range of tasks across the university community.

---

**Sources:** [[544505857]], [[567279621]], [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]], [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]]

results.question: What's MCP at Syracuse and how do I use it?
results.answer:
Here's a comprehensive breakdown of MCP at Syracuse University:

---

## 🔌 What is MCP?

**MCP (Model Context Protocol)** is an open-source standard developed by Anthropic that allows the Claude Desktop app to securely connect to data and tools — files, folders, databases, local apps, and APIs — on your computer or via enterprise integrations [[837517313]]. It's the backbone of how Claude integrates with external systems at SU [[841875458]].

There are **three MCP paths** available at Syracuse:

---

## 1. ✅ Pre-Enabled Enterprise Connectors (Free, No Setup Required)

These are enabled for **all SU users** automatically:

- **Microsoft 365 Connector** — Lets Claude access Teams messages, Outlook emails, SharePoint, and OneDrive. To activate: go to *Claude Settings → Connectors → Microsoft 365 → Connect*, and sign in with your `netid@syr.edu` [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]].
- **Atlassian Connector** — Lets Claude read Jira tickets and Confluence pages [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]].

---

## 2. 🔒 Requesting a New Enterprise Connector (Review Required)

If you want to connect Claude to a third-party SaaS tool not already supported, you can submit a request to **aihelp@syr.edu** with [[841875458]]:
- The connector documentation
- Your business use case
- Vendor contract status
- A **SOC 2 Type II report** from the vendor (the most critical requirement)

ITS reviews requests based on: SOC 2 availability, existing SU contract, data classification risk, campus-wide benefit, and vendor maturity. Requests without a SOC 2 report, without an existing SU contract, or that would expose restricted data are unlikely to be approved [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]].

---

## 3. 🖥️ Local MCP (Claude Desktop — User-Configurable)

Local MCP lets you connect Claude Desktop to tools **running on your own machine** — no enterprise admin approval needed. You're still responsible for following SU data-handling rules for any content you expose to Claude [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]].

### Example: Connecting Claude Desktop to Power BI

Here's the step-by-step process [[837517313]]:

1. **Install the extension:** In VS Code, search for and install the *"Power BI Modeling MCP"* extension published by Microsoft.
2. **Find the `.exe` file:** Navigate to a path like:
   ```
   C:\Users\<YourUsername>\.vscode\extensions\analysis-services.powerbi-modeling-mcp-0.1.9-win32-x64\server
   ```
3. **Copy the path:** Hold Shift, right-click the `.exe`, and select "Copy as path."
4. **Edit Claude Desktop config:** Open the Claude Desktop app and click the "Edit Config" button.
5. **Paste the config in VS Code:**
   ```json
   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "powerbi-modeling-mcp": {
         "command": "paste the path you copied here",
         "args": ["--start"],
         "env": {}
       }
     }
   }
   ```
   > ⚠️ Use **double backslashes** (`\\`) instead of single ones (`\`) in the file path.
6. **Reboot** your computer, then reopen Claude Desktop — the MCP will appear in the app.
7. **Use it:** Open a Power BI report, then prompt Claude with: *"Connect to the open Power BI desktop file"* and Claude will assist with modeling tasks.

You can add multiple MCP servers to the config by separating them with commas [[837517313]].

---

### Also Worth Knowing: The Filesystem Connector

A related local option is the **Filesystem connector** in Claude Desktop, which lets Claude read, edit, and create files in directories you grant access to. A common pattern is to point it at your `OneDrive - Syracuse University` folder (including SharePoint shortcuts) so Claude can work with SharePoint files [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]].

---

**Sources:** [[claude-at-syracuse-product-surface-map]], [[837517313]], [[841875458]]

|---|---|
| **Claude Enterprise** | Anthropic does **not** use your chats/data to train models by default. Only explicitly submitted feedback/bug reports may be used [[488210484]]. |
| **Microsoft Copilot** | Microsoft does **not** use your prompts or interactions from SU accounts to train AI models [[522289260]]. |
| **Google Gemini** | Google does **not** human-review chats or access them to improve AI models [[498597967]]. Gemini for Education is covered by enterprise-grade Google Workspace terms [[498597967]]. |
| **mentorAI** | The corpus does not specify a published policy on vendor access for mentorAI. |

---

## 🗄️ Data Retention (Who Could Theoretically Find It Later)

- **Claude Enterprise**: All chats are retained for **2 years** on the platform — even if you delete them, they remain on the backend [[488210484]].
- **Microsoft Copilot**: Conversations are stored in a **hidden folder in your M365 mailbox**, recoverable/searchable by admins for up to **30 days** after deletion (or longer depending on your mailbox retention policies) [[522289260]].
- **Google Gemini**: No specific retention period is published in the SU corpus [[498597967]].

---

## 🕵️ "Private" or Incognito Modes — A Caveat

Even if you use **Incognito/Temporary Chat** mode:
- **Claude**: Chats are not saved to your visible history, but are still **retained on the platform** under the standard 2-year retention policy [[488210484]].
- **Copilot**: Temporary chats are not saved to your history, but are still **subject to M365 retention policies** [[522289260]].

---

### Bottom Line
Your AI usage data at Syracuse is **not shared with vendors for training purposes**, but **authorized SU IT staff can access it** for support/security/maintenance under established policy, and **data is retained** on the backend even after you delete it. Always treat what you type into these tools as potentially accessible by SU IT under appropriate circumstances.

**Sources:** [[approved-ai-tools-for-university-data]], [[488210484]], [[522289260]], [[498597967]]

results.question: Where can I find example uses of Claude for academic work?
results.answer:
There are **five dedicated example use pages** for Claude in the SU knowledge base. Here's a summary of the ones most relevant to academic work:

---

## 📚 Claude Example Uses for Academic Work

### 1. 🎓 Claude Study Project
Create a *Study Project* inside Claude to master your coursework. You can upload lecture slides, PDFs, and notes, then ask Claude to:
- Summarize chapters
- Explain key concepts
- Generate flashcards and quizzes

**How to start:** Click "Learn" or "Study Project" from the Claude home screen, upload your class materials, and prompt it with something like *"Summarize this PDF into flashcards."* [[511279124]]

---

### 2. 🔬 AI Research Assistant with Claude
Claude can serve as a personal research assistant for literature reviews, source analysis, and academic writing. Key features include:

- **Upload up to 5 documents** (PDFs, Word docs, articles) per conversation for multi-document analysis
- **Use Projects** to organize readings by course — upload once and reference across multiple conversations all semester
- **Create Artifacts** (editable summaries, outlines, literature reviews) in a side panel
- **Extended Thinking** for deeper analysis of complex research questions
- **Web Search Integration** for finding recent studies (note: verify through SU Libraries for peer-reviewed sources)

Example prompts provided include summarizing articles, comparing two sources side-by-side, building a literature review outline, and extracting key quotes with significance notes. [[572194844]]

---

### 3. 💼 Claude Career Project
While career-focused, this is also useful academically for things like tailoring application materials, practicing interviews, and researching organizations. You can upload your resume and a job description and ask Claude to tailor or draft materials for you. [[511246346]]

---

### Other Example Use Pages (also in the same folder):
- **Meeting Summaries** (page `500236296`) — useful for summarizing class or group project meetings
- **Drafting Emails** (page `516325410`) — helpful for professional communication with faculty or advisors

You can access all of these through your SU Claude account at **getclaude.syr.edu**.

---

**Sources:** [[511279124]], [[572194844]], [[511246346]]
